# Local / nonlocal per-step infidelity

Step infidelity = 1 - |<psi_(n+1)| U_midpoint,Suzuki2,reps2 psi_n>|^2. Global infidelity compares each saved state against continuous exact dynamics. Local cost is the original local echo objective and is separately recorded in CSV. No penalties in either run. All numbers below are percentages.
